UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Lakshman Kiriella,Minister of Higher Education and Highways, having obtained a report under Section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respectof the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (Guarantee) Limited, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under thea Companies Act, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing registration number GL 24, do by this Order, amend the Schedule to the Ordermade under the said Act, and published in Gazette Extraordinary, No. 1955/20 of February 25, 2016 by the additionimmediately after the entry “Doctor of Philosophy in Material Engineering” appearing in Column I and it’s correspondingentry in Column II respectively of the Schedule II thereof, of the entries specified under Column I and II respectively ofthe Schedule II hereto, subject to the conditions specified in Schedule I hereto :-
SCHEDULE I
CONDITIONS
Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (Gurantee) Limited, shall when admitting students for the degree programmesspecified in Schedule II hereto in respect of-
(a) the Master of Business Administration, adhere to the minimum entry qualification of -
(i) a Bachelor’s degree with 30 credits passes in the relevant subject area ; or
(ii) a qualification of SLQF level 6 or obove in the relevant area os study
